quality_dimensions.depth: Decomposes the reference lifecycle into buildable units with explicit inputs, outputs, checks, stop conditions, retry behavior, and the final handoff contract.
quality_dimensions.evidence_use: Uses deterministic validators and identity-bound repository evidence for capability, deliberation, transition, promotion, reconciliation, and external-action claims.
quality_dimensions.seed_retention: Carries the reference profile and README contract through implementation planning while preserving scope limits, required lifecycle gates, and the no-live-model deterministic boundary.
quality_dimensions.adjudication: Returns an explicit conflict and preserves both meaningful versions whenever safe automatic reconciliation cannot prove a single canonical result.
quality_dimensions.lifecycle_completeness: Demonstrates every required deterministic stage and refuses outcome advancement or handoff readiness while any required obligation lacks satisfied evidence.
